question: “Kavach” system introduced by Indian Railways is a/an ______.

options.text: System to increase the speed of the trains

solution:
The correct answer is __**Automatic Train Protection System**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has announced that the ‘Kavach’ System, the anti-collision test conducted by the Indian Railways to check the indigenous developed system to avoid rail accidents is successful.
